description: The seed for the whole Tyche set: six buttons choose a number that every Tyche module to its right draws its randomness from

inputs.text: Counts the beat for every Tyche module to the right; it expects 24 pulses per quarter note, and a rising edge past 1V is one pulse
A rising edge past 1V clears the beat count here and sends a reset along the whole chain to the right

notes: the Tyche modules chain rightwards from this one, each passing the seed, the clock and the reset on to the next; a Blank passes them on too
the seed is stored with the patch, so the same button colours give the same random sequences every time the patch is opened
this module has no outputs; everything it does reaches the other modules through the chain rather than through cables
